- Consolidated forecast table: ACV movement, confidence band, and committed vs. best-case.
- Heatmap view of at-risk deals (low/medium/high) with owners.

I'm sending a first-pass template attached (QBR_vignette_template.docx). If any account needs a separate ask to legal/procurement, call it out explicitly in the vignette — we'll escalate.

Goal: final slides to me by Friday 7/30 9am PT. If you can't meet that window, tell me now.
